title: Set up your website
subtitle: A few quick steps. You can change everything later.

website.title: What's your website?
website.description: We'll look at it to detect the platform, your brand and your languages.
website.label: Website address

details.title: Check your details
details.description: Here's what we found for {{domain}}. Correct anything that's wrong.
details.name: Website name
details.platformHint: This decides how we connect and which fix instructions you get.
details.brandHint: How customers and AI assistants refer to you.
details.industryHint: In a few words, e.g. "dental clinic".
details.countryHint: Two letters, e.g. SA or US.
details.competitorsHint: One website per line. We compare you with them.

languages.title: Which languages should we track?
languages.description: We track rankings and AI answers in each language you choose.
languages.arabicDetected: We found Arabic content on your website. Add Arabic if you want to track it too.
languages.arabicBrandHint: Optional. Helps us spot mentions written in Arabic.
languages.planNote: Some plans include Arabic as an add-on. If your plan doesn't, we'll let you know.

tracking.keywordsDescription: Searches your customers type into Google.
tracking.promptsDescription: Questions customers ask ChatGPT, Gemini and others.
tracking.empty: Nothing here yet. Add your own below.

connect.title: Connect your website
connect.description: Best options for {{platform}}, recommended first. Connecting lets us apply approved fixes for you.
connect.clientSide: Visible to Google, not to most AI crawlers
connect.snippetLimitation: About the snippet: Google runs JavaScript, so changes added by the snippet generally work for Google. Many AI crawlers don't run JavaScript, so for AI visibility a server-side method (plugin, app, SDK, edge worker, pull request or manual paste) works better.
connect.comingSoon: Automatic connections are being built. For now you can finish setup and connect later from Integrations.
connect.verifyDescription: Add this tag to your homepage's <head> (or use a DNS record or a connected app). We need it before applying any fix.

wpPlugin.title: WordPress plugin
wpPlugin.body: Install our plugin. It adds approved schema and meta tags server-side and works alongside Yoast or Rank Math.

shopifyApp.title: Shopify app
shopifyApp.body: Install our app. It updates SEO titles and descriptions and adds structured data through your theme.

wixApp.title: Wix app
wixApp.body: Connect with Wix to update page SEO tags and structured data directly.

webflowApp.title: Webflow app
webflowApp.body: Connect with Webflow to update page SEO fields and CMS items. You publish the changes.

sdk.title: JavaScript SDK
sdk.body: Install our npm package. It loads approved fixes on the server, e.g. in Next.js generateMetadata.

api.title: REST API and webhooks
api.body: Pull approved fixes into your own code and get notified when they change.

github.title: GitHub pull requests
github.body: Connect a repository and we open pull requests with fixes for your team to review.

edgeWorker.title: Cloudflare edge worker
edgeWorker.body: If your site runs through Cloudflare, a small worker adds fixes to your HTML before it's sent.

snippet.title: Snippet
snippet.body: Paste this line once into your site's <head> (header code / custom code settings).

manual.title: Manual instructions
manual.body: Copy each fix yourself with step-by-step instructions for your platform.

plan.title: Your plan
plan.description: You're on the plan below. You can start tracking right away.
plan.limits: Up to {{sites}} website(s), {{keywords}} keywords and {{prompts}} AI questions.

notices.unreachable: We couldn't open your website (it may be down, slow or blocking bots), so please fill in the details yourself.
notices.ai_unavailable: We read your website, but AI analysis isn't switched on yet, so industry, city and competitors may be empty. Please fill them in.
notices.ai_failed: We read your website, but the AI analysis didn't finish. Please check and complete the details.
notices.budget: Your monthly AI budget is used up, so we only read the basics from your website. Please complete the details.
notices.template: These are example suggestions (AI suggestions aren't available right now). Edit them so they match how your customers search.
